cohort: The study included 353 schoolchildren and adolescents with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) from Latin American cities, predominantly male and white.
finding: Over half (58.9%) of Latin American schoolchildren and adolescents with ASD presented DGBI, with functional constipation being the most common (27.2%), and those from Central America had a higher likelihood of presenting a DGBI (OR = 1.98).
